title: Multilingual Conceptual Coverage in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multilingual conceptual coverage by generating images for translated tangible nouns across seven languages and measuring their distinctiveness, self-consistency, and cross-consistency (correctness) relative to a source language using CLIP image embeddings.

Identifying specific and generic concept collisions across languages, such as observing whether prompts in specific languages (e.g., Hebrew) spuriously generate stereotyped geographic or cultural imagery (e.g., desert scenes) instead of the requested tangible concept due to training data correlations.
